name: 46406 · Gary, IN
findings: ZIP 46406 (Gary) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46406 (Gary) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46406 (Gary) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
